rationale: C18 plausibly supplied a material letter template: both letters request that a named private-sector leader undertake a public-service assignment, invoke the recipient's relevant experience or interest, and express confidence that his participation will provide substantial value. The shared sequence and unusually close phrasing are stronger than generic appointment-letter conventions. C08 is structurally related through committee designation and reliance on personal interest and responsibilities, but its language and function are less closely matched. C14 concerns committee service and appreciation but is primarily retrospective and lacks the same appointment-request structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This note is to request that you accept appointment to the Committee for Traffic Safety as the representative of businessmen.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It would be a great service to the nation's capital if you would undertake to confer with the appropriate agencies in an effort to bring about agreement on a workable program.
shared_material.explanation: Both directly ask the recipient to undertake a defined public-service assignment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In view of your demonstrated interest in traffic accident prevention in California, I am certain that your participation in the work of the Committee will be of great benefit.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As the President of the Federal City Council, and with your broad experiences in civic affairs, I am certain you can render a service of great value.
shared_material.explanation: The sentences share a distinctive construction: cite the recipient's relevant background, then state certainty that his service will be highly valuable.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I sincerely hope that you will be able to undertake this responsibility. With warm regard, Sincerely,
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I shall welcome a report of successful progress. With best wishes, Sincerely,
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the requested assignment with an expression of anticipated participation or success followed by a cordial closing.
